# Costa Mesa Jiu Jitsu

> Brazilian Jiu Jitsu gym for kids (from age 4) and adults at 2428 Newport Blvd, Unit 7, Costa Mesa, CA 92627 (Orange County). Gi and NoGi classes, private lessons, a free open mat on Saturdays, and a free first class. Call or text 949-556-1178. Email info@costamesajiujitsu.com.

## Key facts
- Location: 2428 Newport Blvd, Unit 7, Costa Mesa, California 92627
- Programs: Little Ninjas (ages 4 to 6), Youth Jiu Jitsu (ages 7 to 12), adult Gi and NoGi Jiu Jitsu, free Open Mat on Saturdays
- Head coach: Tony Misitano, Brazilian Jiu Jitsu black belt. Black belt coaching every class.
- First class: free for kids and adults
- Private lessons: 1 to 4 people per lesson, groups split the cost. Parent and kid lessons and family lessons are popular.
- Memberships: Unlimited Adult $189/month, Unlimited Kids $179/month, Family Add-On $120/month, 10-Class Pack $250 one time
- Booking, memberships and payments: the member portal at https://eldojo.ossdojo.com/member

## Weekly jiu jitsu schedule
- Monday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth Gi 5:15 PM, Adult Gi 6:15 PM
- Tuesday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth NoGi 5:15 PM, Adult NoGi 6:15 PM
- Wednesday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth Gi 5:15 PM, Adult Gi 6:15 PM
- Thursday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth Gi 5:15 PM, Adult Gi 6:15 PM
- Friday: Little Ninjas 4:15 PM, Youth NoGi 5:15 PM, Adult NoGi 6:15 PM
- Saturday: Open Mat 11:00 AM (free, all ages)
